verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment kept apart from production is a fair question for a hosted realtime communications platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a sandbox, test mode, staging environment, or isolated test credentials for Cloudflare Realtime. The free tier and the general APIs are pricing and platform features, not a documented sandbox, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
